name.en-US: Treatise on the Miracles of St. Francis (Tractatus de miraculis)
name.pt-BR: Tratado dos milagres de São Francisco (Tractatus de miraculis)

description.la: Thomae de Celano Tractatus de miraculis beati Francisci (1250-1252), de stigmatibus, dominio super creaturas, curationibus et aliis miraculis post mortem, XIX capitibus.
description.en-US: Thomas of Celano’s Treatise on the Miracles of St. Francis (1250-1252): the stigmata, his power over creatures, healings and the miracles after his death, in nineteen chapters, in Latin. No public-domain English translation exists.
description.pt-BR: O Tratado dos milagres de São Francisco, por Tomás de Celano (1250-1252), em dezenove capítulos.

la.editor: transcription of the critical text of Fontes Franciscani (1995) by M. Mastrorilli, Politecnico di Bari; edition not stated

sources.edition: Thomas of Celano, Tractatus de miraculis, poliba.it "Fonti francescane" (Wayback Machine snapshot).
sources.description: Nineteen chapters, paragraph numbers bold, verse numbers superscript. Latin only; no public-domain English exists.
sources.tierEvidence: Medieval text. The transcription (M. Mastrorilli, Politecnico di Bari, Biblioteca di Scienze del Cristianesimo, 2000-02) survives only in the Wayback Machine; it states no edition, but its biblical apparatus follows Fontes Franciscani (1995). Free in practice, edition unverified.

title.la: Caput I - Quod ortus religionis suae mirabilis fuit.
Caput II - De miraculo stigmatum et modus apparitionis Seraph ei apparentis.
Caput III - De dominio quod habuit super creaturis insensibilibus, et primo de igne.
Caput IV - De dominio quod habuit super sensibilibus creaturis.
Caput V - Qualiter desideriis sancti Francisci praesto fuit semper divina clementia.
Caput VI - De domina Iacoba de Septem Soliis.
Caput VII - De mortuis suscitatis per merita beati Francisci.
Caput VIII - De iis quos a fauce mortis ad vitam reduxit.
Caput IX - De hydropicis et paralyticis.
Caput XI - De carceratis et vinctis.
Caput XII - De liberatis a periculo partus et de non servantibus eius festum.
Caput XIV - De caecis et surdis et mutis.
Caput XV - De leprosis et sanguifluis.
Caput XVI - De insanis et daemoniacis.
Caput XVII - De contractis et confractis.
Caput XVIII - De quibusdam diversis miraculis.
Caput XIX - Finalis conclusio miraculorum beati Francisci.
